Confirm.description: The engine/confirm secret from the Credential Locker, re-typed per write in the UI. Custom header, so a page on another origin cannot set it without a CORS preflight this engine never grants, and a local process would have to guess 43 characters.
Confirm.name: X-Kira-Confirm

reason.description: shown to the model when the answer is deny

ApprovalInfo.description: One ask-policy tool call waiting on a decision. The arguments are what the model wanted to run, never a secret.

BudgetRow.description: cap null means unlimited, and then remaining is null - a bar with no right edge, not a full one.

ChainRecord.description: One routing decision. Every attempt, skip, failure and tool run is visible.

id.description: who goes on stage; null takes everyone off

CharacterCapability.description: One PMX, measured by walking it. The same code writes this at import and the CLI shows it.

counts.description: the nine section counts, each null when the walk could not earn it

is_character.description: the body test: bones and vertices, decided engine-side

name.description: as the file wrote it, in its own script

path.description: relative to the character's folder; the body is always `model.pmx`

trailing_bytes.description: bytes past the last section the walk reached

unreadable.description: why nothing was measured, in words

version.description: 2.0 or 2.1; the only two this reader walks

deleted.description: the removed character's id; its folder and its pick are both gone

path.description: a .pmx or .zip on this machine, typed or picked by the desktop app — never a device

active.description: who is on stage, or null. A pointer at a folder that is gone reads null, never the stale id

CharacterProfile.description: One character, whole: the body, the props that came with it, and every file in its folder.

files.description: everything in the folder, so a missing texture is visible without a second request

main.description: the body the stage loads, or null when the archive has none

schema.description: which report fields this profile was made from

CharacterRow.description: The library list item: enough to choose a character without opening its folder. Every number here was written by the import that measured it.

companion_count.description: the other models in the same archive

id.description: `<slug>-<8 hex>`; the folder name, and the id every other route takes

is_character.description: false when the archive held only props

reason.description: why this model was chosen as the body

sha256.description: of the source bytes; importing them again answers already_imported

source_file_name.description: the archive or file it was imported from

ChatChunk.description: One SSE `data:` frame on /v1/chat/completions when stream=true.

ChatCompletion.description: Non-streaming response. Mirrors chat.completion plus Kira provenance.

CheckpointFile.description: One file a checkpoint holds. `existed: false` means the write created it, so restoring deletes it.

CheckpointInfo.description: One pre-write snapshot. `restore` itself takes a checkpoint whose tool is 'restore'.

checkpoint_id.description: the safety checkpoint this restore took

force.description: restore over files that changed since the checkpoint

DailyUsage.description: Only days inside the selected month, oldest first: the sparkline plots exactly these points.

code.description: Kira codes: already_imported, bad_archive, budget_exhausted, character_exists, character_file_not_found, character_not_found, config_error, download_failed, download_refused, image_backend_missing, image_generation_failed, image_not_found, image_request_invalid, internal_error, llm_start_failed, llm_unavailable, model_not_found, no_pmx_in_archive, not_a_pmx, pairing_refused, pmx_truncated, pmx_version_unsupported, providers_exhausted, rate_limited, secret_store_unavailable, too_large, unauthorized, unsafe_entry, unsupported_source, unsupported_version. Provider-side failures add: provider_error, rate_limited, provider_5xx, provider_4xx, bad_stream, bad_tool_call, stream_error, plus any code string the provider itself sends, so treat this as open-ended.

entry.description: what a character refusal is about, when it has a name: the archive entry that climbed out of the folder, the id that is not in the library, the source path the caller supplied. Carried beside `message` so a screen can point at the thing without parsing a sentence.

FieldStateBool.description: One tunable boolean: what config.yaml says, what the settings table overrides, what the router uses.

FieldStateCap.description: Monthly token cap. null means unlimited at every level, so a null effective value is not 'missing'.

HealthzResponse.description: The one endpoint outside the version namespace, because it is how a caller finds out which namespace this engine serves. Both versions are published here: `api_version` says whether the paths still mean what the caller thinks, `contract_version` says whether the fields did.

model.description: a name from ImagesStatus.models; absent picks the first

seed.description: -1 picks one and the answer carries it

ImageModel.description: One checkpoint this machine can draw with. The name is the filename without its extension, and it is what a generation request names.

ImageOutput.description: One generated PNG and the settings that made it, as the sidecar recorded them.

backend.description: local for the managed executable, remote for KIRA_SD_URL

name.description: the PNG's filename; the id the file and delete routes take

url.description: the authenticated path the bytes are fetched from

ImagesStatus.description: What the Images screen needs to draw a form or say why it cannot: the engine, the checkpoints, and the gallery.

backend.description: local, remote, or null when neither is configured

reason.description: why nothing can draw yet, in the words the screen shows

version.description: export format, not the API version

snippet.description: the engine brackets the match with [ ]

tokenizer.description: read-only: which index tokenizer this SQLite build gave us

MemorySettingsPatch.description: a subset of the three writable switches; strict-typed, so a prose boolean like "yes" is 400, and `tokenizer` is not writable

MessageRow.description: One stored message, with the chain that produced it when it is an answer.

usage.description: Stored with engine-internal names, not the OpenAI-style wire names.

key_present.description: Whether the vault holds this provider's key. False means either 'a key is wanted and missing' or 'no key is wanted'; `needs_key` tells them apart.

needs_key.description: False for a provider that asks for no credential — a local server on loopback. Read with `key_present`: false here means 'nothing to store', never 'broken'.

success_rate.description: (turns - interrupted - failed) / turns; null when turns is 0 because 'no data' is not '0% healthy'

name.description: 1-40 characters, shown in the device list

token.description: shown once, and only its SHA-256 is stored engine-side

code.description: 8 characters from 0-9 and A-Z without I, L, O or U

expires_at.description: unix seconds; the code dies after 120

PluginInfo.description: One file in the plugins directory. A bad file is 'skipped' with its reason, never a startup failure.

ProbeResponse.description: One live probe. A failure is ok:false with the reason, never an HTTP error, so the UI can show it inline. Probe traffic is not stored as a conversation and does not count toward a month's spend.

latency_ms.description: the one-cap completion only; null for a list-only probe

ProviderSettings.description: The four tunable fields, as base/override/effective after a write.

ProviderState.description: Cooldown ledger view. `cooling_s` counts down; 0 means ready.

ProviderView.description: A provider as the router currently sees it. `name`, `kind`, `base_url`, `models` and `vision` are config.yaml-only.

key_ref.description: Credential Locker ref name. Never the value.

needs_key.description: False when the stanza declares no `key_ref` and none is wanted — a local server on loopback. A dashboard must not call that row 'no key'.

vision.description: True only when config.yaml says this endpoint accepts images, which is what lets a call attach a webcam frame to an answer.

month.description: YYYY-MM the spend figures are for

orphan_settings.description: 'provider.key' rows the settings table holds but config.yaml no longer has a provider or a tunable key for

RecentIssue.description: A turn that did not finish cleanly, newest first, at most ten.

RefusalRecord.description: A turn the plan refused before a session existed. No message row can hold it; this ledger is the record.

RefusalSummary.description: Refusals in the window. They are not in `turns`: a refusal writes no message row, so counting it there would invent a turn that never started.

SessionRow.description: One session with what it cost. `last_used_at` is the newest message timestamp, null for an empty session.

tokens.description: input + output, combined, as every other total in this contract

SettingsRequest.description: Any subset of the tunable fields. null deletes that override and returns to config.yaml; monthly_cap 0 means unlimited - the two must not be confused.

discovery.description: how a model reaches a method: no methods, the names are in the use_skill schema, or search_skills finds them

reason.description: why a start would refuse, in the screen's words

model.description: a GGUF name; absent picks the first

StudioStatus.description: The Portable AI Studio components Kira can see, or Kira's own folders when there is no studio.

declared.description: the path the material table wrote, verbatim: `tex\\颜.tga` stays a windows path

escapes.description: the declared path points outside the character folder: never fetched

format.description: png/bmp/tga/... from the bytes, '' when unread

relative.description: normalised to posix, relative to the model's own folder

size.description: bytes on disk, null when it does not exist

ToolInfo.description: One callable tool: its JSON schema, the risk class, where it came from and what it is set to now.

policy.description: override if set, else the default

ToolPolicyRequest.description: null deletes the override and returns the tool to its risk default.

VoiceStage.description: One half of a call. `available` is whether the configured mode can actually run here; `detail` names the missing install or provider problem verbatim, so a client never has to guess why listening or speaking is off.

max_utterance_s.description: Longest single utterance the VAD will hand to STT.

silence_ms.description: Quiet time that closes an utterance.

vision.description: The provider webcam frames would go to, or null when no enabled provider declares `vision: true` — then frames stay on this device.

estimated.description: true when the provider sent no usage and the engine estimated it

get.description: Little-endian and consumed to the last byte: `KRM1` | u32 format | u32 vertex | u32 face index | u32 bone | u32 material | u32 texture | u32 vertex morph, then the position, normal, uv, skin, face, texture, material, bone and morph blocks in that order. The path is the library's own — the profile the importer wrote names the model — so a caller can ask for nothing that is not already here. A paired device may ask: showing the avatar is a read.

200.description: the KRM1 blob; the format version is the word after the magic, and a stage that does not know that number refuses the bytes instead of drawing them
